[!dolt] skip
# Test bd set-state, bd state, and bd state list
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Witness issue' --description 'Carries operational state' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd state $ISSUE patrol
stdout 'no patrol state set'

bd set-state $ISSUE patrol=active --reason 'Patrol enabled' --json
jq '.changed'
stdout 'true'
jq '.new_value'
stdout '"active"'
jq '.event_id'
stdout 'test-'

bd state $ISSUE patrol --json
jq '.value'
stdout '"active"'

bd state list $ISSUE --json
jq '.states.patrol'
stdout '"active"'

bd set-state $ISSUE patrol=active
stdout 'no change'
